_doc: Stun Grenade (attacker pool; research/gadgets.md §3.5). Thrown; it bounces and goes off 2 s after the first bounce (siege.gg), 3 s after the throw when it never bounces (Fandom). Its count for Striker (3 on Fandom's Striker page, 2 on the generic one) and its size are placeholders. Its flash (M3): blind and deaf for 5 s; facing it, fully blinded within 11 m and less out to 15 m; facing away, only within 3 m; ringing ears within 8 m whatever the facing (Fandom, last changed in Y1). Cameras and drones aren't affected, nor those watching them; a deployable shield's slits let it through (Fandom).
name: Stun Grenade
